movement.Title: Movement
movement.Hint: Changes to the walking speed and extra modes. Blank stores nothing.

statCaps.Title: Stat caps
statCaps.Hint: The highest score a stat may have. Blank is no cap.

requires.Title: Requires
requires.Hint: Tags a crawler must (or must not) have to take this.

add.Label: Add damage
add.OptionHint: A Rank damage die is not doubled on a Critical Hit.

Option.rank: Rank die (not doubled on a crit)

reflect.Label: Damage Reflection
reflect.Hint: When one blow costs the holder at least this many Health Bar slots, the holder may make the attacker lose slots.

evadeOutcome.Label: Area Evade
evadeOutcome.Hint: What a successful Evade does against an area attack.

assist.Label: Assist dice
assist.Hint: Changes the dice an assist skill (Call a Play, Intervene) rolls. Never touches ordinary checks.

reroll.Label: Reroll after the roll
reroll.Hint: After the check is rolled, its roller may roll it again and keep the new result. When the row sits on an item, that item's cooldown gates each use.

degreeShift.Label: Shift the degree
degreeShift.Hint: After the check is rolled, its roller may move the result's degree by Value steps. A Fail never shifts past Near Miss into a success. When the row sits on an item, that item's cooldown gates each use.

waive.Label: Waive a roll penalty
waive.Hint: The roll penalty named by the option does not apply to the rolls this row matches.

item.Label: Item
item.Hint: Gives this item (gear, loot, a consumable or a skill potion) when the box is opened.

spell.Label: Spell tome
spell.Hint: Gives a Tome of this spell, read later to learn it at the listed Rank.

gold.Label: Gold
gold.Hint: Adds gold when the box is opened. A whole number or a dice formula such as 2d6*10.

table.Label: Roll table
table.Hint: Rolls the table when the box is opened and gives what it rolls. It can roll several times, and turn each roll into a skill potion of a custom Skill or a placeholder item.

magicItem.Label: Generated magic item
magicItem.Hint: Generates a fresh magic item when the box is opened. A blank tier uses the box's own tier.

choice.Label: Choice
choice.Hint: The opener picks one thing matching the tags: an item, a Tome of a spell, or a potion for a skill.

stat.Label: Stat bonus
stat.Hint: Adds to one Stat, sized by the box tier. A second Stat result picks a different Stat.

skill.Label: Skill bonus
skill.Hint: Adds Skill Ranks to a skill the crawler owns (any skill when they own none), sized by the box tier.

passiveSkill.Label: Passive skill
passiveSkill.Hint: Grants a passive skill at the current floor's number.

spell.Label: Spell
spell.Hint: Grants a spell at a Rank sized by the box tier, with 2 hours of cooldown per Rank.

resistance.Label: Resistance
resistance.Hint: Resistance to one of the listed damage types. With no list, the GM picks the type.

buff.Label: Buff
buff.Hint: A benefit the GM decides. Recorded on the item for the GM to finish.

restore.Label: Restore
restore.Hint: A restoring effect the GM decides. Recorded on the item for the GM to finish.

maxBonus.Label: Highest bonus level
maxBonus.Hint: The most this crafter can enchant at. Above it the craft asks a Rule Break. The highest matching row wins; with no matching row there is no limit.

time.Label: Crafting time
time.Hint: Multiplies the hours a craft takes (0.5 halves them). Matching rows multiply.

batchTime.Label: Batch time
batchTime.Hint: Multiplies the minutes a batch adds for each extra unit. Matching rows multiply.

rebuild.Label: Rebuild destroyed items
rebuild.Hint: A Repair check can rebuild a destroyed item without a Rule Break. Condition it on item.destroyed.

tableTier.Label: Table tier multiplier
tableTier.Hint: Multiplies the crafting table's tier for checks this row matches. 0 = tables give no bonus.

bonusValue.Label: Extra bonus value
bonusValue.Hint: Adds this much to the numbers an enchantment writes, with no extra Difficulty or time.

moveAdd.Label: Move added
moveAdd.Hint: Adds feet to the vehicle's Move. Rows add together, then the multipliers apply.

moveMultiply.Label: Move multiplier
moveMultiply.Hint: Multiplies the vehicle's Move after the additions (1.5 adds half again). Matching rows multiply.

hpSlotsLost.Label: Health Bar slots lost
hpSlotsLost.Hint: Empty Health Bars on the row owner, or on the target when damage is applied.

rank.Label: Rank
rank.Hint: The Rank of the item carrying the row, the item used, the weapon skill, or an owned item.

stat.Label: Stat Mod
stat.Hint: The row owner's modifier for the chosen stat.

statValue.Label: Stat score
statValue.Hint: The row owner's score (not the modifier) for the chosen stat, such as seconds equal to Intelligence.

count.Label: Count of creatures
count.Hint: Party members, allies, enemies or owned items matching a tag query.

move.Label: Move
move.Hint: The row owner's Move in feet (write per: 0.1 for "per 10ft").

CopyBlueprint.Hint: GM only. Writes a new blueprint from this item's enchantments.
CopyBlueprint.Name: {name} Blueprint
